about: Adjudicated type of every judge-UNSUPPORTED numeric claim (claim text contains a digit) in the three same-image 40-ticker runs, 2026-10-05. Read by eval/error_types.py, which checks the list is complete against the claims files. Model errors = wrong value + wrong label. Evidence: docs/eval-methodology.md, 'GPU SLM extended run p9jr2'.

types.wrong value: the figure is not the context's value (model error)
types.wrong label: the figure is in the context but attached to the wrong quantity (model error)
types.source conflict: the figure is quoted correctly from one context source; another context source disagrees and the judge held the claim against it
types.judge error: the claim is correct against the context; the verdict is wrong
types.not in context: the claim asserts something the context does not contain, with no figure misquoted
